turns.assessment: The outage pattern is a simultaneous failure of many unrelated ODU services whose working paths all depend on the S15 OTN switch, while protected services switched away. The critical OTN_FABRIC_FAIL alarm at otn.S15 occurred at the same instant, and unchanged optical power, OSNR, BER, and amplifier telemetry strongly excludes a line-system or ROADM failure. This is an S15 OTN switch-fabric failure.

proposals.rationale: E1 is common to every affected working path and raised OTN_FABRIC_FAIL exactly when all client failures and protection switches occurred. The broad multi-service impact matches interruption of every ODU cross-connected through the fabric, while unchanged optical telemetry contradicts an optical-layer cause.
